question: A naturally occurring geological rock sample currently contains two radioactive isotopes $I_1$ and $I_2$ in a $1:1$ ratio of active nuclei. If their half-lives are $T_1 = 10^9 \text{ years}$ and $T_2 = 10^8 \text{ years}$ respectively, what was the exact ratio of their nuclei ($N_1 : N_2$) in the rock exactly $2 \times 10^9 \text{ years}$ ago?
